dedupe_keys.name: contextual outlier detection in traffic data

description: The implemented thesis models expected Lisbon metro traffic with calendar information, public events, interventions and citizen notifications. It compares neural forecasting with autoregressive moving-average and triple-exponential-smoothing methods, and supports contextual outlier detection and spatiotemporal exploration. Related ILU reports extend the context-analysis programme to bus and bike-sharing observations; those extensions are retained as related studies, without claiming one identical executable or dataset. The metadata catalogue explicitly records event and incident inputs. Prediction accuracy is not quantified in the inspected thesis abstract, and future operational forecasting performance remains unverified. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with restricted document or data access and licence label not stated. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
